 Necaxa 1 – 1 FC Juárez González 26' Dupuy 82' FULL TIME Necaxa vs FC Juarez LIVE Score Updates in Liga MX Match
 Get real-time updates on Necaxa vs FC Juarez live coverage, minute by minute of the 2026 Liga MX Apertura Matchday 14 with VAVEL.
 Coverage by Daniel Medina Pérez Updated October 23, 2026, 11:03 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FULL TIME Last update 11:03 PM ET 11:03 PM ET 2 hours ago Necaxa and Juárez share the points
 Full-time at Estadio Victoria! Necaxa and FC Juárez play out a 1-1 draw. Owen González put the Rayos ahead in the 26th minute, but Luca Martínez Dupuy equalized for the Bravos in the 82nd. Necaxa had a chance to extend their lead from the penalty spot, but Julián Carranza failed to convert. In the end, both teams take a point after a match that delivered drama until the closing stages.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 Key moments
 10:55 PM ET 86' Yellow card 
 10:51 PM ET 82' Goal by Luca Martínez Dupuy · 1-1 
 10:47 PM ET 76' Yellow card 
 10:13 PM ET 46' Second half 
 9:59 PM ET The first half comes to an end at Estadio… 
 9:32 PM ET 26' Goal by Owen González · 1-0 
 9:04 PM ET 1' Kick-off 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 90+1' 11:01 PM ET 2 hours ago Juárez continue to press! Leonardo Rodríguez gets his head to a cross from Denzell García in the centre of the box, but the Necaxa defense blocks the effort before it can reach the goal. The Bravos are looking to build on their equalizer and push for a comeback.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 86' 10:55 PM ET 2 hours ago Óscar Estupiñán is shown a yellow card in the 86th minute. FC Juárez are looking to maintain their pressure after finding the equalizer, while Necaxa search for a late response to regain the lead. The score remains 1-1 at Estadio Victoria.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 10:51 PM ET 2 hours ago JUAREZ ⚽ ⚽ GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAL⚽ ⏱️ 82'
 GOOOOOAL FOR FC JUÁREZ! The Bravos find their equalizer in the 82nd minute! Luca Martínez Dupuy gets on the end of the corner and fires a right-footed shot from close range into the net. Juárez kept pushing and are now back on level terms at Estadio Victoria. Necaxa 1-1 FC Juárez.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 81' 10:48 PM ET 2 hours ago Corner kick for FC Juárez! Raúl Martínez concedes the corner, giving the visitors another opportunity to threaten Necaxa's box. Juárez keep pushing and will look to make the most of this set piece as they search for an equalizer in the closing stages.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 76' 10:47 PM ET 2 hours ago Miguel Pedroza is shown a yellow card in the 76th minute. Necaxa will need to stay focused during the closing stages as FC Juárez continue searching for a chance to level the score. The Rayos remain 1-0 ahead.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 71' 10:39 PM ET 2 hours ago The match was briefly stopped after José Luis Rodríguez of FC Juárez picked up an injury and required medical attention on the pitch. Following a few minutes of delay, play resumes at Estadio Victoria.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 66' 10:36 PM ET 2 hours ago Necaxa make another substitution in the 66th minute. Francisco Méndez comes on to replace Lorenzo Faravelli as the Rayos look to freshen up their midfield and protect their 1-0 lead against a Juárez side still searching for an equalizer.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 61' 10:31 PM ET 2 hours ago Juárez are pushing for an equalizer! Denzell García takes a right-footed shot from outside the box after being set up by Madson, but the Necaxa defense gets in the way and blocks the attempt. The visitors are trying to increase the pressure as they search for a goal to level the score.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 56' 10:24 PM ET 2 hours ago Juárez win a corner after Mauro Zaleta concedes it, but Necaxa respond with another set-piece opportunity, this time won off Francisco Nevárez. Both teams are looking to make the most of these situations early in the second half.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 51' 10:23 PM ET 2 hours ago Corner kick for Necaxa! Rodrigo Dourado gives away the corner, handing the Rayos another chance to create danger from a set piece. With only a one-goal lead, the home side will look to make the most of this opportunity and move closer to a second goal.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 46' 10:13 PM ET 3 hours ago The second half is underway at Estadio Victoria! Necaxa remain 1-0 ahead of FC Juárez and make two changes at the break: Mauro Zaleta replaces Carlos Vargas, while Emilio Rodríguez comes on for Matías Espíndola. The Rayos look to freshen things up for the final 45 minutes.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 9:59 PM ET 3 hours ago The first half comes to an end at Estadio Victoria!
 Necaxa head into the break with a 1-0 lead over FC Juárez, thanks to Owen González's 26th-minute goal, confirmed after a VAR review. Juárez had chances to level the score, but Javier Orantes stood firm in goal. Another 45 minutes remain to decide the outcome.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 45+3' 9:57 PM ET 3 hours ago Necaxa make a change early in the second half. Necaxa make their first substitution of the match in the 48th minute. Danny Leyva comes on to replace Javier Ruiz as the Rayos look to maintain control and protect their 1-0 lead against FC Juárez.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 45+1' 9:57 PM ET 3 hours ago FC Juárez continue searching for an equalizer as José Luis Rodríguez tries a left-footed shot from the left side of the box. However, his effort flies high and wide to the right. The visitors are creating opportunities, but they still need more accuracy to beat Javier Orantes.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 41' 9:46 PM ET 3 hours ago Necaxa survive a dangerous moment! Francisco Nevárez delivers a cross into the box, and Óscar Estupiñán gets his head to it, aiming for the top centre of the goal. However, Javier Orantes makes the save to preserve Necaxa's lead. Juárez come close to equalizing, but the Rayos goalkeeper stands firm.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 36' 9:46 PM ET 3 hours ago Necaxa come close to doubling their lead! Carlos Vargas takes a direct free kick and unleashes a left-footed shot from outside the box that narrowly misses the top-right corner. The Rayos threaten again as FC Juárez remain 1-0 down.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 31' 9:39 PM ET 3 hours ago FC Juárez look for a response after Necaxa's opening goal. Francisco Nevárez tries his luck with a right-footed effort from outside the box following a pass from José Luis Rodríguez, but his shot flies high and wide to the right. The visitors are still searching for an equalizer.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 9:32 PM ET 3 hours ago NECAXA ⚽ ⚽ GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAL ⚽ ⏱️ 26'
 GOOOOOAL FOR NECAXA! Owen González puts the Rayos ahead in the 26th minute! He fires a right-footed shot from the centre of the box into the top-right corner, leaving the Juárez goalkeeper with no chance. The goal was reviewed by VAR and officially confirmed. Necaxa 1-0 FC Juárez.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 21' 9:27 PM ET 3 hours ago The first 20 minutes are gone at Estadio Victoria, and the score remains 0-0. Both teams have looked to move forward and threaten their opponents, but neither has found the finishing touch needed to turn their attacks into a goal.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 16' 9:22 PM ET 3 hours ago The first 15 minutes are complete at Estadio Victoria, and Necaxa are starting to create chances. Raúl Martínez fires a right-footed shot from the right side of the box, but the FC Juárez goalkeeper makes the save to keep the score level.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 11' 9:15 PM ET 3 hours ago FC Juárez look to make something happen! Leonardo Rodríguez fires a left-footed shot from outside the box after a headed pass from Guilherme Castilho, but his effort goes wide to the right. The visitors are searching for an opening goal.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 6' 9:10 PM ET 4 hours ago Corner kick for Necaxa! Jesús Murillo gives away the corner, handing the home side an opportunity to create danger from a set piece. The Rayos will look to make the most of this chance and test the FC Juárez defense.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 1' 9:04 PM ET 4 hours ago We're underway! Necaxa and FC Juárez finally get this Liga MX clash started after a few minutes of delay from the scheduled kickoff time. The ball is rolling at Estadio Victoria, and both sides will be looking to settle into the game, gain control of possession, and create the first scoring opportunities. Let the action begin!
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 9:01 PM ET 4 hours ago Kickoff Is Just Seconds Away!
 The wait is almost over! Necaxa and FC Juárez are just seconds away from kicking off this Liga MX encounter at Estadio Victoria. Both teams have confirmed their starting lineups and are ready to take their positions on the pitch. Everything is set, and all that remains is the referee's whistle to get the action underway!
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 9:00 PM ET 4 hours ago FC Juárez confirm their starting lineup
 FC Juárez have also announced their starting eleven for this Liga MX clash. Captain Sebastián Jurado will lead the team as the visitors look to stay organized defensively, compete in midfield, and make the most of their attacking opportunities against Necaxa.
 FC Juárez starting XI: S. Jurado (captain); F. Nevárez, J. Murillo, G. Sepúlveda, D. Piña; L. Silva, R. Dourado, M. de S. Silva, G. Castilho, J. L. Rodríguez; Ó. Estupiñán.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 8:59 PM ET 4 hours ago Necaxa confirm their starting lineup
 Necaxa will line up in a 4-1-4-1 formation, with Julián Carranza leading the attack. The home side will look to maintain balance in midfield, connect with its attacking players, and find spaces to threaten FC Juárez.
 Necaxa starting XI (4-1-4-1): J. Orantes; J. Palacios, K. Naves, A. Oliveros (captain), C. A. V. Tenorio; L. Faravelli; R. Martínez, J. Ruiz, M. Espíndola, O. González; J. Carranza.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 8:58 PM ET 4 hours ago Starting lineups confirmed
 The starting elevens are in! Both Necaxa and FC Juárez have confirmed their lineups for this Liga MX encounter. The managers have selected the players who will begin the match, and both sides are now focused on putting their game plans into action when the referee blows the opening whistle.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 8:58 PM ET 4 hours ago Teams warming up on the pitch
 The players of Necaxa and FC Juárez are already going through their warm-up routines on the pitch. Both teams are completing their final physical and tactical preparations ahead of this Liga MX clash, with kickoff getting closer and the atmosphere building at Estadio Victoria.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 8:57 PM ET 4 hours ago Welcome to Necaxa vs FC Juárez!
 Welcome to our live coverage of the Liga MX clash between Necaxa and FC Juárez! Both teams will be looking to impose their style and secure an important result in Mexican football. Stay with us for every key moment, scoring opportunity, and all the action from Estadio Victoria. Kickoff is getting closer!
